messages:
Raj: kicking off onboarding for xenith-22b v2 — weights staged at gs://redwood-models/xenith-22b/v2. Short checklist: weights location, tokenizer quirks, config lint, attn compatibility (RoPE scaling), and MQA/GQA mode. Who wants to own which item?

Tess: I can take tokenizer. quick note: tokenizer.json looks like a hybrid (BPE + spm) and we saw weird splits on non-breaking-space (U+00A0) during corpus tests.

Alex: ran a quick tokenization smoke. example: "Hello\u00A0world" -> ["Hello", "\u00A0world"] which breaks downstream detokenization. Proposing normalize NBS to regular space in pretokenizer.

Alex: quick check command I used:
```
python -m tooling.tokenizer_check \
  --model-dir gs://redwood-models/xenith-22b/v2 \
  --sample "Hello\u00A0world"
```

deploy-bot: weights copy complete -> staging nodes at /mnt/models/xenith-22b/v2 on fleet-rack-3 :white_check_mark:

Raj: great. Alex, can you validate the config for attention? config.json currently has `attn_impl: "scaled_rotary"` and `rope_scale: [per_head]`. Our runtime expects a single scalar rope_scale. Also verify kv cache shape and whether model intends MQA or GQA.

Sam: heads-up: this checkpoint uses per-head rotary bases (per_head list) and a dynamic scaling schedule — our runtime doesn't accept per-head lists. We should either reduce to a single scalar (max) or extend runtime mapping. I can prototype a mapper.

Tess: I'll add a tokenizer validator that normalizes NBS -> space and emits a warning if vocab contains non-normalized tokens. PR incoming in ~1h (wip).

Alex: :thumbsup:

Raj: config lint command to run before canary deploy:
```
./tools/config_lint --model /mnt/models/xenith-22b/v2/config.json --rules attn,rope,tokenizer,mqa
```

Tess: also found `mqamode: "auto"` in config — we should make this explicit ("GQA" or "MQA") before shipping. I'll add a lint rule to fail on auto.

Sam: I'll run a small serve smoke with sliding-window tests (start 2048 -> 8192) to validate KV cache eviction and performance. ETA ~2h. If we see KV drift, we'll fall back to fixed-window mode.

Raj: if sliding window fallback is required, add a route-level fallback to the lighter variant. I filed INFR-322 for the fallback policy and rollout notes.

oncall: canary deploy started: xenith-22b -> rack-3-canary-1. Monitoring hooks enabled.

Alex: one more gotcha: vocab size reported 51024 — our embedding allocation prefers 512-multiple padding. If mismatch, we'll pad embeddings (zero pad) to nearest 512 boundary to avoid alignment issues.

Tess: noted. will pad only if runtime fails otherwise.

Raj: action summary: Tess -> tokenizer mapping & validator PR; Sam -> smoke serve + KV tests; Alex -> config lint and vocab pad plan. I'll watch canary metrics in #eng-runtime-canary and post results. Report back here after smoke pass.

Sam: ack

Tess: ack

Alex: ack
